name: Ayame
source:
Ayame is a citizen of Konohagakure and a waitress at her father's restaurant, Ramen Ichiraku. Ayame is a slender woman with long, dark brown hair and large black eyes, plus fair skin. She wears a white robe with the sleeves folded, a sort of dark blue apron with ribbon ties at the top and a bright white bandanna.

[In game description]
